evidence_backed_direction.measured_failure: V10 passed deterministic construction, exact packed-scale closure, 169/169 V9-relative non-regression, strict aggregate BF16 SSE improvement, and all 312 Dynamic Scale32 events, but failed the mandatory construction-blind quality gate at 4/8 exact token arrays and 7/8 response-gate outcomes.
evidence_backed_direction.stopped_directions: Do not repeat two-bank selector granularity changes, source-SSE-only objective changes, activation-weighted objectives, covariance objectives, or terminal-candidate replay. V3 through V10 show that those changes do not close exact token identity.
evidence_backed_direction.replacement_hypothesis: Increase decision-facing weight representation capacity from two to four signed-Q4.4 codebook banks per 128-input block and select one bank per output row and block with two bits. Fund the added selector and bank metadata by constraining each tensor to four legal Scale32 exponents and storing every row as a 16-bit normalized significand plus a two-bit palette index.
evidence_backed_direction.distinctness: V11 is constructed directly from the pinned BF16 source under a new namespace. It does not reconstruct, resume, replay, or mutate V10; V10 per-tensor SSE values are used only as a frozen non-regression ledger.

model.source_alias_assertion: lm_head.weight and model.embed_tokens.weight are the same Parameter and storage immediately after pinned-model load

weight_policy.payload_packing: row-major output row then input lane; even flat index in low nibble and odd flat index in high nibble

four_codebooks.ordering: bank 0, bank 1, bank 2, bank 3; byte offset within a bank equals payload index

quaternary_row_selector.semantics: unsigned values 0 through 3 select the matching codebook bank
quaternary_row_selector.packing: two-bit selectors are concatenated least-significant-bit first, each tensor stream is padded to a 16-byte boundary, and all unused padding bits are zero

palette_scale18.palette_entry_format: strictly increasing signed int8 Scale32 exponents in [-24,+4]
palette_scale18.row_record_fields: bits 15:0 normalized unsigned-Q1.15 significand in [32768,65535]; bits 17:16 unsigned palette index 0 through 3
palette_scale18.row_record_order: increasing output-row ordinal, packed least-significant-bit first immediately after the four palette bytes
palette_scale18.decode_rule: select the signed exponent from the authenticated tensor palette, restore a zero reserved high byte, and form the legal Scale32 record before arithmetic

construction_algorithm.data_source: pinned BF16 weights, authenticated source/model identities, and the sealed V10 per-tensor SSE ledger only
construction_algorithm.initial_bank_partition: for each tensor and 128-input block, sort output rows by exact BF16 block energy, tie by row ordinal, partition into four contiguous near-equal buckets, and derive one globally optimal strictly increasing 16-entry signed-Q4.4 codebook per bucket with the reviewed exact dynamic program
construction_algorithm.initial_selector: select the bank associated with the row's deterministic energy bucket
construction_algorithm.initial_exponent_palette: with initial selectors and codebooks fixed, compute each row's exact best legal Scale32 exponent; select the four most frequent exponents, tie by lower exponent, and fill any missing entries with the nearest unused legal exponents in ascending order
construction_algorithm.selector_assignment_step: with payload, row records, exponent palette, and four codebooks fixed, evaluate exact BF16 source-space SSE for all four banks independently for every output row and input block; choose the lowest cost and then the lower bank id
construction_algorithm.payload_assignment_step: assign every weight to the nearest reconstructed level in its selected bank under the decoded row scale; exact-distance ties choose the lower payload index
construction_algorithm.row_record_step: for each row and each palette exponent, evaluate the legal normalized-significand records bracketing the exact dyadic least-squares ideal, their immediate neighbors, and the prior record; choose minimum exact row SSE, then lower exponent index, then smaller positive scale, then smaller significand
construction_algorithm.palette_update_step: precompute exact row cost for every legal exponent, then make deterministic coordinate sweeps over the four sorted palette entries; each replacement considers every unused legal exponent and accepts the minimum aggregate exact row cost, with lexicographically lower sorted palettes winning ties
construction_algorithm.codebook_update_step: for each input block and selected bank independently, accumulate exact per-cluster quadratic costs and use the reviewed dynamic program to choose the globally minimum strictly increasing 16-entry signed-Q4.4 codebook; an empty bank retains its prior codebook and ties choose the lexicographically lower bank
construction_algorithm.iteration_acceptance: exact per-tensor SSE may not increase from the preceding full iteration; execute all eight iterations even after a fixed point

activation_policy.payload: signed A8 symmetric range -127 through +127 with -128 reserved
activation_policy.selection_rule: preserve the authenticated base activation Scale32 significand and choose the minimum legal integer exponent delta covering every live group without saturation

pre_attempt_closure.representation_gate: Two independent V11 builds must match byte-for-byte; all four exponent palettes, 18-bit row records, four-bank codebooks, two-bit selectors, payloads, padding, identities, and manifests must be legal and exact; all 169 tensors must be non-regressing against the sealed V10 per-tensor SSE ledger and aggregate literal BF16 SSE must be strictly below 2153.4047236346078.
pre_attempt_closure.non_evaluator_quality_gate: The unchanged eight construction-blind non-evaluator inputs must achieve 8/8 exact BF16 token arrays and 8/8 matching BF16 response-gate outcomes before an official marker may be created.
pre_attempt_closure.dynamic_gate: A fresh V11 candidate must cover all 312 named activation boundaries with legal deltas, zero saturation, zero clipping, no reserved -128 payload, and no more than 832 activation-metadata bytes per decoder-layer token.
pre_attempt_closure.failure_disposition: Preserve a hash-bound PREATTEMPT_NO_GO, leave attempt-0001 absent and unconsumed, keep selected_policy_id null, and submit the no-go to a Fresh Reviewer without accessing official inputs.

official_attempt.generation: deterministic greedy argmax; no sampling; use_cache=false; maximum six generated tokens; termination IDs 151643 and 151645
official_attempt.score_policy: binary only: 9/9 complete token arrays exactly equal BF16 and 9/9 response-gate outcomes equal BF16
official_attempt.evaluator_no_execution_rule: If execution_started.json exists but no candidate prompt completes, preserve the attempt, keep numerical correctness null, and forbid replay.
official_attempt.numerical_failure_rule: If any candidate prompt completes but the binary gate is not met, set eligible=false, preserve exact disagreements, keep selected_policy_id null, and forbid replay.
official_attempt.numerical_success_rule: If the 9/9 binary gate is met, seal immutable evidence and submit it to a Fresh Reviewer; do not select the policy or authorize downstream work before independent acceptance.

risk_register: The four-entry exponent palette reduces row-scale exponent freedom; four codebook banks must recover more representation value than the palette constraint removes.
The standard-layer and lm_head cap reserves are only 4228.48 and 4397.952 bytes. Every palette byte, alignment byte, selector pad bit, and codebook byte is binding and must fail closed on mismatch.
Improved weight SSE has not predicted exact token closure. The 8/8 construction-blind gate remains decisive and precedes any official attempt.

An accepted numerical policy would still require a Manager stage advance, focused RTL regression, one fresh tree-specific PPA after any core RTL change, local arbitrary-text demo acceptance, and later U280 work.
